next.name: curl
tip: Invoke an RPC endpoint, a la cURL.

option.name: --cacert
tip: Path to a PEM-encoded X509 certificate pool file with the set of trusted certificate authorities.
Only valid for the https scheme; not applicable with --insecure.

option.name: --cert
tip: Path to a PEM-encoded X509 certificate file for client certificates with TLS.
Only valid for the https scheme. A --key flag must also be present.

option.name: --connect-timeout
tip: The time limit, in seconds, for a connection to be established with the server.
There is no limit if this flag is not present.

option.name: --data
tip: Request data. Zero or more JSON documents, each indicating a request message.
For unary RPCs there should be exactly one JSON document.
A value of @<path> reads data from a file; - reads from stdin.

option.name: --emit-defaults
tip: Emit default values for JSON-encoded responses.

option.name: --header
tip: Request headers to include with the RPC invocation, each in the form name: value.
A value of @<path> reads headers from a file; - reads from stdin.

option.name: --http2-prior-knowledge
tip: Indicate that HTTP/2 should be used.
Without this, HTTP 1.1 is used for http URLs, and protocol negotiation is used for https URLs.

option.name: --http3
tip: Indicate that HTTP/3 should be used.
Without this, HTTP 1.1 or HTTP/2 is chosen by protocol negotiation.

option.name: --insecure
tip: Make the TLS connection insecure and do not verify the server's certificate.
This is generally discouraged. Only valid for the https scheme.

option.name: --keepalive-time
tip: The duration, in seconds, between TCP keepalive transmissions. Default: 60.

option.name: --key
tip: Path to a PEM-encoded X509 private key file for client certificates with TLS.
Only valid for the https scheme. A --cert or -E flag must also be present.

option.name: --list-methods
tip: List supported methods and then exit.
With server reflection the URL must be a base URL, not including a service or method name.

option.name: --list-services
tip: List supported services and then exit.
With server reflection the URL must be a base URL, not including a service or method name.

option.name: --netrc
tip: Examine .netrc in the user's home directory for credentials, sent via a basic authorization header.

option.name: --netrc-file
tip: Like --netrc, except the named file is used instead of .netrc in the user's home directory.
Cannot be used with the --netrc or -n flag.

option.name: --output
tip: Path to output file to create with response data.
If absent, the response is printed to stdout.

option.name: --protocol
tip: The RPC protocol to use. Default: connect.

option.name: --reflect
tip: Use server reflection to determine the schema. Default: true.

option.name: --reflect-header
tip: Request headers to include with reflection requests, each in the form name: value.
May only be used when --reflect is also set.
A value of * includes all normal request headers from --header and -H.

option.name: --reflect-protocol
tip: The reflection protocol to use for downloading information from the server.
May only be used when server reflection is used.

option.name: --schema
tip: The module to use for the RPC schema, necessary if the server does not support server reflection.
Setting this implies --reflect=false unless a reflect flag is explicitly present.

option.name: --servername
tip: The server name to use in TLS handshakes for SNI if the URL scheme is https.
Defaults to the origin host in the URL or the value in a Host header.

option.name: --unix-socket
tip: The path to a unix socket that will be used instead of opening a TCP socket to the host and port in the URL.

option.name: --user
tip: The user credentials to send via a basic authorization header, in the format username:password.
If the value has no colon it is assumed to be just the username and you are prompted for a password.

option.name: --user-agent
tip: The user agent string to send.

option.name: --disable-symlinks
tip: Do not follow symlinks when reading sources or configuration from the local filesystem.
By default, symlinks are followed in this CLI, but never followed on the Buf Schema Registry.

tip: The format for build errors printed to stderr.
